core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghina corresponds to the Arabic form غناء (Arabic root غ ن ي (gh-n-y); غناء (ghināʾ)). Its core sense is song, singing. Ghina is Arabic غناء (ghināʾ) 'song, singing', from the root غ ن ي.
